meta.homeDescription: International symposium on the dispersal and restitution of Canarian archaeological heritage. November 12–13, 2026, TEA, Santa Cruz de Tenerife.

hero.headline: A Canarian perspective on the dispersal and restitution of archaeological heritage
hero.description: Diásporas Patrimoniales is an international forum promoted from the Canary Islands, aiming to place Canarian archaeological heritage held outside the archipelago within one of today's major cultural debates: how museums, universities, and heritage institutions should relate to the territories of origin of the objects they hold.
